# Sources and notices

NASSP 9 and the Apollo 7 crew procedures come from the [NASSP prerelease source](https://github.com/dcajacob/NASSP/tree/apollo7-post-sps3-linux-opengl-preview1). The source includes the Linux CMake project, the pinned Orbiter build recipe and patches, the corrected SPS-3 seed, and the replay verifier under `.github/native-linux/`. The NASSP license and Project Apollo linking exception accompany this installation.

The native Orbiter host, OpenGL renderer and XRSound bridge use [Orbiter revision f37eeee6](https://github.com/dcajacob/orbiter-cross-platform/tree/f37eeee6ec8a757c9daa07fff0eeeec704d1e655) with the surface-texture patch in the NASSP build recipe. XRSound's notice is under `resources/XRSound/ReadMe.txt`. The OpenGL renderer and VesselBuilder1 license notices are under `engine/NativeModules/`. VesselBuilder1 uses [revision 4f332ec4](https://github.com/fredenigma/VesselBuilder1/tree/4f332ec4e6fa80e1a63d8d920bb50e033c5b67f6). Font licenses for Cousine, Lekton, Roboto and Font Awesome accompany this file.

The installer obtains the Orbiter 2016 terrain from the [preserved publisher archive](https://github.com/dcajacob/orbiter-cross-platform/releases/tag/production-inputs-v2). This preview uses the selected terrain for non-commercial simulation. The original manual, including section 28.1, and the publisher's readme are installed alongside these notices. Stock Orbiter data retain their respective notices. Credit for the SPICE toolkit and ephemerides belongs to NASA/JPL/NAIF and the source data teams. [NAIF acknowledgments and distribution information](https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/naif/rules.html)
